description: This file defines a class InsecureSHA1PRNGKeyDerivator that provides a custom implementation of a key derivation using an insecure SHA-1 based pseudo-random number generator. It includes methods for deriving keys from seeds and internal mechanisms for hashing and random byte generation.

classes.name: InsecureSHA1PRNGKeyDerivator
classes.description: A custom pseudo-random number generator implementing a SHA-1 based key derivation, intentionally insecure and deprecated on Android.

methods.name: deriveInsecureKey
methods.description: Derives an insecure cryptographic key from a seed byte array for a specified key size.

methods.name: updateSeed
methods.description: Updates the seed state with additional bytes.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Sets or appends to the seed used for key derivation.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills a byte array with pseudo-random bytes generated based on the seed and internal state.

methods.name: computeHash
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a 16-word message block, updating hash state.

methods.name: updateHash
methods.description: Updates the hash input array with new bytes, handling buffer logic.
